market.source: Ndax public CAD spot order books

dataset.note: Native BTC is Kraken XBT. LINK/CAD is derived as LINK/ETH close × ETH/CAD close on the exact same daily candle timestamp; those separate markets' last trades need not be simultaneous. These are spot reference closes, not Ndax fills or historical order books. Kraken documents a 720-entry recent-history limit including an unfinished bar; this loader conservatively retains at most 719 completed matching dates. No backward pagination, filled gaps, synthetic prices or invented high/low prices. Dates label the exchange's daily candles; they are calendar labels, not Eastern midnight timestamps. Coverage is too short for the proposed multi-year untouched walk-forward study.
dataset.source: Kraken public spot daily OHLC: XBT/CAD, ETH/CAD and LINK/ETH

sentiment.method: Fixed headline lexicon with explicit title asset matching and short negation window; not a prediction model
limitations: Headline language is not measured public opinion, verified event impact or a probability of profit.
The title lexicon can miss context, sarcasm and events whose effect differs between assets.
Missing asset headlines remain unavailable, not neutral. Publisher coverage is incomplete.
Current headlines are not inserted into historical backtests. These snapshots support prospective records only.

notes: Fees and current spread/depth are included in fills. Additional slippage allowance is deducted once from the forecast.
Venue minimums/increments can leave small residual holdings. Actual fills determine the final allocation.
Causal mean of ridge penalties 1 and 10; uncertainty is not a calibrated probability.
Price forecasts use completed prices and matured outcomes. Current sentiment adds context, not an invented validated return uplift.
Execution and forecast entry prices differ; expected profits are estimates, not guarantees.

rationale: Owner-selected allocation evaluated with causal price forecasts and current execution costs. Frozen six-pair technical/sentiment evidence is contextual; historical sentiment was not fabricated.
